offer.text: The nets came up empty today. Could you bring me 8 cod so the village eats well tonight?

accept.text: Bless you. The sea owes us all a favor now and then.

decline.text: Hmph. More for the gulls, then.

ready.text: Eight fine cod! Hand them over and I'll square up.

complete.text: You'll always have a place at my table.
